column1: # US-075 (AC 5): every jar of two Windows 10 x64 builds (Temurin 27+35, Maven 3.10.0, -Djfx.build.timestamp=2026-11-13-000000), before = 36123c04a8, after = 36123c04a8 plus the US-075 change, 2026-11-13. build java = mvn -B -ntp clean verify -DskipNative=true -DskipTests; build native = mvn -B -ntp -fae clean verify -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore=true -Djfx.web.skipFfmTests=false. Jar paths: modules/<module>/ and buildtools/jslc/ and tests/system/ are target/ jars, sdk-lib/ is sdk/target/sdk/lib. Entries are counted raw (ZipInputStream) and compared by name and SHA-256 of their content; added/removed/changed give the count and the names. The only differences are META-INF/legal/ plus the module's notices in the 4 module jars with notices and their 4 SDK copies.
